commentary_segments.text_raw:
At high currents however,
the MOST transistor
changes region again. This
time velocity saturation
emerges. Most electrons
now move through the
channel at maximum speed.
The result is that the current
increases linearly with the
voltage drive and the trans-
conductance levels off.
Again, a different model is
required. We are especially
interested in finding out
where the transition point is
between strong inversion
and velocity saturation.
This is explained next.
